cases.name: Trineisha Dené Colomb
cases.about: Her dad Sterling Colomb, Sr. and brother Sterling Colomb, Jr. said like her father, Dene was in the military, serving about two years in the Army and planning to join the Marines. "She was outgoing and she liked to experiment things, travel," said Colomb, Sr. "She wanted to travel because she was teaching herself different languages."
cases.caseStatus: CASE NEVER TRIED; CODIS / DNA MATCH
cases.narrative: On 11/24/2002, a hunter discovered her body in a wooded area off of Renaud Drive in Scott, LA. He had abducted her from a cemetery where she was visiting her mother's grave.
